description: Inline column or overlay drawer with header, optional toolbar, optional search row, scrollable content area, and optional action-bar footer. Inline panels collapse to a narrow strip with a chevron toggle and an optional vertical restore label. Use the built-in `data-search` flag (or a `slot="search"` override) to turn the panel into a searchable list panel.

attributes.name: data-restore-label
attributes.description: Vertical label shown on the collapsed strip

attributes.name: data-flush
attributes.description: Removes content padding (slotted child owns gutters)

attributes.name: data-search
attributes.description: Renders a built-in search row and filters slotted items

attributes.name: data-empty
attributes.description: Empty-state message when search yields zero matches (default: `No results`)

attributes.name: data-busy
attributes.description: (AI variant) Disables new-chat and archive buttons

slots.description: Default slot for panel body content

slots.name: controls
slots.description: Header control buttons (placed before the collapse button)

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Toolbar row between the header and the content area

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Action bar pinned to the bottom of the panel

slots.name: suggestions
slots.description: (AI variant) Prompt suggestions shown when thread is empty

slots.name: composer
slots.description: (AI variant) Prompt-composer pinned above the footer

events.name: panel-close
events.description: Fired when the collapse / close button is clicked

events.name: panel-search
events.description: Fired when the search filter changes

methods.name: clearSearch()
methods.description: Clear the search field and reset visibility
